notes: ACCESS: All live www.qvc.com listing pages (including the roster N-17h8 URL and every /c/.../c.html category page) are behind Akamai Bot Manager and returned HTTP 418 'currently unavailable' to every access route tried: direct fetch, 24 curl_cffi impersonation profiles (chrome/edge/safari/firefox, desktop+mobile, single-request and session-with-referer), WebFetch (418), r.jina.ai (percent-encoded, retried twice, itself Cloudflare-challenged/contended both times per Rule 2), translate.goog (same origin 418 reached even Google's proxy IP), and alternate subdomains (m./mobile./search./www2./app.qvc.com: DNS/timeout). This is a genuine hard block, not a missing-route gap. STRUCTURE: the site publishes clean per-department XML nav sitemaps (https://www.qvc.com/sitemap-us-navigation-for-the-home.xml etc, 200 OK, unblocked) giving the full, real category tree with canonical /c/.../c.html URLs -- used for all category discovery and for every 'link' below. COUNTS: discovered an unblocked JSON search API at api.qvc.com (api/product/v5/us/search) that requires a non-empty 'searchTerm' (empty/absent triggers the same WAF block) but otherwise returns the site's own live merchandising facets. Verified empirically (Rule 1) that generic/stopword search terms ('the','for','home') act as pass-through (no filtering effect) once a facet+groupId is locked: for every facet tested, all three stopword-terms returned an IDENTICAL totalElements while unrelated restrictive terms ('and','with') returned smaller subsets -- this 3-way convergence is the evidence cited per row. Two DIFFERENT internal facet dimensions exist ('Type' 258e vs 'Decorative Accents Type' 5suc0 vs 'Product Type' 259b vs 'Collectibles Type' 5subz) and sometimes disagree on the same-named value (e.g. Candleholders 99 vs 137, Figurines 718 vs 677) -- for those I picked the 5suc0 'Decorative Accents Type' number (the dimension that gave clean, unambiguous, convergence-verified matches for Mirrors/Vases/Picture Frames/Indoor Fountains/Stained Glass/Boxes) and flagged the competing number for manual review rather than silently dropping the row. Clocks (126) and Desk & Project Lamps (15) are exact sums of individually convergence-verified, mutually-exclusive sibling facet values under one facet group (not an estimate: each addend was independently verified 3x before summing). EXCLUDED per rules: Home Fragrance/scented candles, faux plants/wreaths, window treatments, decorative pillows, slipcovers, all furniture/bedding/storage/rugs/mattresses/laundry/tools/pet/baby/automotive/sports-fan sections of For the Home and Garden & Outdoor Living; Baskets dropped as ambiguous decor-vs-storage (not in the brief's explicit include list, cross-listed under Storage & Organization in the nav). Kitchen & Food > Tabletop & Bar exists (likely holds dinnerware/glassware) but the nav sitemap does not enumerate its children and the page itself is blocked, so it was not extracted -- flagged for a future pass. Garden & Outdoor Living has no dedicated lighting branch (no outdoor/landscape lighting node found on QVC; Indoor Lighting is the only lighting department). RULE 0: Indoor Lighting's room-type split does not exist on QVC (fixture-type only, no by-room nodes), so Rule 0 mainly gained clock/lighting/mirror SUBTYPES rather than room branches; no category was skipped for containing a room word.
